entities.name: Penthikos
entities.description: Akroan phalanx soldier who broke formation seeking Iroas's blessing, doomed his companions, was sentenced by the king, and walks the road to the Underworld.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God of Victory whose favor the narrator sought.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God whose angry eye falls on the narrator.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God of the forge, whose anvil is compared to the heated stone bed.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead who is suffering and finds peace only through the pain of others.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God who ferries the dead across the river and takes funerary masks as payment.

entities.name: Robed woman at the shore
entities.description: Coin-tossing robed figure who questions the narrator at the river's edge.

entities.name: Akroan king
entities.description: King of Akros who sentences the narrator to be set apart forever.

entities.name: Pharagax Bridge
entities.description: Place the narrator once defended with companions.

entities.name: Titan's Stairs
entities.description: Stairs descended to reach the Phoberos badlands.

entities.name: Phoberos badlands
entities.description: Badlands attacked by beasts while the narrator's phalanx held it.

entities.name: Kolophon
entities.description: Sheer cliffs scaled by the narrator to reach Akros.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: Land of the dead across the river.

entities.name: The Returned
entities.description: Gold-masked soldiers of the dead who destroy the Akroan phalanx.

entities.name: Akroan phalanx
entities.description: Phalanxes of Akros, whose ranks the narrator left in disorder.

events.summary: Penthikos breaks formation to charge a mob of beasts, leaving his phalanx exposed.
events.quote: breaking formation and running ahead, eager to wet my blade

events.summary: The Returned close in on the Akroan companions and kill them while Penthikos is far ahead.
events.quote: I heard my shieldmates curse me as they died.

events.summary: Penthikos reaches Akros and tells the king what befell his fellows; the king sentences him.
events.quote: He heard my tale. He gave his orders. He pronounced my sentence.

events.summary: Penthikos prays to the gods to expiate his hubris and is answered, freed from shackles.
events.quote: Let me expiate my hubris, O gods!

events.summary: Penthikos descends a cave, kills shades, and black ichor encases his face.
events.quote: With every blow, more of the foul ichor poured down my face.

events.summary: Penthikos reaches the river's edge and meets a robed woman who tells him he has no face to pay the boatman.
events.quote: You bring no face for the boatman. How will you cross?

events.summary: Penthikos defies fate and crosses the river, paying his crystallized mask to the ferryman.
events.quote: The price paid, we drifted across to that bleak land.

relations.note: served in the phalanxes of Akros
relations.quote: Serving in the phalanxes of Akros

relations.note: ferries the dead of the god of death
relations.quote: But I will not give the god of death his satisfaction.
